search.label: Search for a Riot account
search.helper: Three characters are enough. Suggestions come from accounts the site already knows: the Riot API cannot search by partial name.
search.noSuggestionDescription: That is expected while few games have been collected. Type the full Riot ID, then ask Riot: the account will join the list.

verify.helper: Account not in the list? Type the full Riot ID and ask Riot. This links nothing: the account joins the list, and clicking is what picks it.
verify.needsFullId: To ask Riot, type the full Riot ID: a single #, with text on both sides.
verify.done: {{riotId}} confirmed by Riot. Pick it from the list.
verify.unavailable: Verification with Riot is unavailable. Try again in a moment.

errors.notFound: Riot does not know that Riot ID.

ingest.title: Riot collection
ingest.subtitle: What the Riot connector collects, how fast, and how much it weighs.
ingest.loadFailed: Could not read the collection state
ingest.unavailable: The Riot connector does not answer: the collection state is unknown.

queue.title: Collection queue
queue.description: All requests together: players, team games and background collection.

crawler.title: Background collection
crawler.description: It reads the history of accounts met in our games, most recent first, so a new player finds their games already there. It always comes after players' requests.
crawler.toggleHelper: Setting for this environment only. In production it runs permanently.
crawler.storageAlert: The database passed the {{threshold}} threshold: background collection is suspended.
crawler.storageHint: Past the threshold, background collection suspends itself.
